sharedBuildTools.purpose: pinned wasi-sdk, patched wasi-libc, Wasm memory cap and name-section verification

adaptation.supported: The upstream evaluator, parser, CLI, stdin and file processing are compiled unchanged apart from explicit WASI host-operation guards.
adaptation.rejected: system() and input/output command pipes fail with diagnostics because Waffle has no host process API for them.
adaptation.notClaimed: This package does not claim complete POSIX, GNU awk, locale, or host-process parity.
